findings.issue: Two definite nouns after traerá can be read as subject plus object; both Hebrew nouns stand with the 3ms subject and there is no object marker.
desde fixes the mem-preposition as spatial source; that prefix on construct blood also allows a partitive reading, and the verse has no separate direct object.

notes: Person, number, hiphil stem, bull, and tent-of-meeting phrase otherwise follow the token sequence.
